Population increased in West Oxfordshire

The estimated population of West Oxfordshire in 2024 was 120,941 usual residents, a rise of 1.4% since 2023.

This meant that West Oxfordshire's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of West Oxfordshire increased by 5.1%.

Over this slightly longer period, West Oxfordshire was also among the 20% fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of West Oxfordshire

The average (median) age fell to 43.8 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of West Oxfordshire has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
West Oxfordshire is an area that is classed as rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, West Oxfordshire's population of 120,941 usual residents was made up of:

  • 21,479 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.8%)
  • 72,487 people aged 16 to 64 years, (59.9%)
  • 26,975 people aged 65 years and over, (22.3%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, West Oxfordshire has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (22.3% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In West Oxfordshire, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in West Oxfordshire
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for West Oxfordshire, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 86 people (-0.1%). In total, there were 1,065 births and 1,151 deaths in West Oxfordshire.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 1,267 (1.1%). There were 7,348 people entering the area and 6,081 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in West Oxfordshire's population of 765 (0.6%) as a result of 1,248 people entering the area and 483 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for West Oxfordshire was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of West Oxfordshire in mid-2023 is 119,221.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 470 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 580 people.

Overall, there was an revision downwards of 110 people.
